speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: As a small, low-lying city state, Singapore is vulnerable to the impacts of climate change, such as sea level rise and more frequent extreme weather events.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: A historic, new global climate agreement was adopted in Paris in December 2015 under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore played an active role in forging consensus on the Agreement.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Our UNFCCC pledge is an ambitious one and will require concerted effort by all stakeholders, including the Government, businesses, households and individuals.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Existing policies and measures will need to be enhanced; new initiatives will also be introduced.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: This will involve significant adjustments to the way we lead our daily lives.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Stakeholders will be engaged to gather feedback on the enhancements and new measures needed.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Enhanced energy efficiency will play a key role in our efforts to manage emissions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will promote the adoption of more efficient industrial and power generation technologies and encourage the use of more energy-efficient buildings, transportation and household appliances.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will also study ways to harness more clean energy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: More categories of appliances will be added to the scheme over time.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: With reduced energy consumption, businesses and consumers will enjoy cost savings.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will also continue to invest in research and technology to develop innovative solutions to address Singapore's needs in the areas of energy, emissions reduction, water and land use.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: As Singapore's base of green companies expands, Singaporeans can look forward to more high-value jobs in exciting new areas, such as solar energy, energy storage solutions and clean transportation, and contribute to improving our quality of life and living environment.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Page: 59 Meeting our climate commitment will require everyone to play a part.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will promote climate awareness through public education and outreach programmes.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will build capacity in and support efforts by the people, private and public sectors for climate action.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Together, we can build Singapore as an enduring and sustainable home which current and future generations of Singaporeans can enjoy and be proud of.
